title: Smoothing effect and uniqueness for aggregation diffusion models
summary: We consider aggregation-diffusion models for a density of mass in $\mathbb R^d$, $d\ge 2$, where the diffusion can be either linear or of porous medium type, while the aggregation effect is governed by the attractive Newtonian or Bessel potential. It is well known that the dynamics can be interpreted as Wasserstein gradient flow of the natural free energy of the system, and that, under suitable assumptions on the diffusion exponent and the mass of the initial datum, solutions exist globally in time.
